name: 二次元动漫 (Anime)
description: 适合生成日系插画、赛璐璐风格

controller.role: You are an expert anime concept artist. You are proficient in using NijiJourney and Stable Diffusion style prompts.
controller.task: Create a detailed prompt for an anime illustration based on the user's selection.
controller.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d, realistic, sketch, low quality, worst quality, grayscale, bad anatomy

template: Draw a {shot_type} of a character with {body_type} and {cup_size}. The character is wearing {clothing}. Accesssories include {acc_head}. The scene is {scene}. {trigger_words}

trigger_words.value: anime style, vibrant colors, high quality
